name: LDL receptor related protein 5

function.text: LRP5 is the approved symbol for LDL receptor related protein 5. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in coreceptor activity; Wnt receptor activity; adipose tissue development.

germline.text: Retained strong or definitive GenCC associations include LRP5-related exudative vitreoretinopathy (autosomal recessive); osteoporosis-pseudoglioma syndrome (autosomal recessive). Allele and inheritance require review.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Cancer Hotspots source tumor code: cscc; Lung adenocarcinoma; Pancreatic adenocarcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

function.text: LRP5 encodes LDL receptor related protein 5. Based in part on similarity, it functions as a coreceptor with members of the frizzled family of seven-transmembrane spanning receptors to transduce signal by Wnt proteins. It activates the canonical Wnt signaling pathway that controls cell fate determination and self-renewal during embryonic development and adult tissue regeneration. It functions as a coreceptor for non-Wnt proteins, such as norrin/NDP.

germline.text: Germline disease associations include LRP5-related exudative vitreoretinopathy (autosomal recessive); osteoporosis-pseudoglioma syndrome (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving LRP5 have been reported in lung adenocarcinoma, prostate adenocarcinoma, and pancreatic adenocarcinoma.
